rule: Read ordered separated panels. Drop each panel's rigid piece into an empty panel-sized canvas, keeping its columns and entering at row zero, until further descent hits the floor or earlier pieces. Original fixtures contain three 5x5 panels.
scope: Default random scenes use three square panels of side 4..9, with 5 weighted twice. Optional counts 2..4 and sizes 4..14 are supported when total width count*size+count-1 <=30. Original three-panel 5x5 fixtures are unchanged; other dimensions/counts are explicitly synthetic extrapolations. Background 7, separator 6 and alternating piece colours 1/5 remain fixed. Shapes include bars, rectangles, rings, T/L/plus shapes and small random connected polyominoes. Entry collisions are excluded in random scenes.
constraints: Every piece lies inside one input panel and is nonempty.
Consecutive random pieces alternate colours 1 and 5.
Each random piece enters the output at row zero without collision.
The concatenated grid has at most 30 columns.
Background 7 is strictly the most frequent input colour.
known_limitations: Size and panel-count extensions are mechanism extrapolations, not additional original examples.
Only rigid vertical falls are generated: no sideways movement, rotations or line clearing.
Background, separator and alternating palette are fixed.
Random polyominoes are small; large arbitrary free-form pieces are not sampled.
Bounded rejection raises without a canned fallback. Explicit fixtures retain the saved solver's entry-overlap semantics; random scenes exclude overlap.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback
